newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Paper says worst of cycle now over.
newsitem.headline: FCL Paper says worst of cycle now over.

text.p: Fletcher Paper Chief Executive John Hood said on Wednesday the 1996/97 financial year probably represented the worst of the pulp and paper inventory cycle, which led to a poor trading performance.

"We believe our strategic and operating initiatives have shaped a stronger publications papers platform for the business going forward. This, along with firmer markets for our key products, will result in an improved performance in 1998," he said.
